function: The box-reflect property is used to create a reflection of an element.

values.function: Default value. No reflection is displayed.
Creates a reflection below the element.
Creates a reflection above the element.
Creates a reflection to the left of the element.
Creates a reflection to the right of the element.

Two value syntax: - position sets reflection below, above, left, or right of the element. - offset sets the distance to the reflection. Distance is set in px, pt, cm, etc. Default value is 0. Read about length units

Three value syntax: - position sets reflection below, above, left, or right of the element. - offset sets the distance to the reflection. Distance is set in px, pt, cm, etc. Default value is 0. Read about length units - gradient sets a transition for the reflection, i.e. a fading effect.
Sets this property to its default value. Read about initial
Inherits this property from its parent element. Read about inherit
